Name: Event Black Bars
Author: gzhynko
Description:
A simple SMAPI mod that adds cutscene-like black bars to the top and the bottom of the screen during an event with configurable height.

[size=4]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿.
[*]Download this mod and unzip its folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4]Compatibility
[/size][list]
[*]Compatible with SMAPI 3.12 and higher (the latest version is recommended).
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5 and higher.
[/list]

Event Black Bars is [url=https://github.com/gzhynko/StardewMods/tree/master/EventBlackBars]open-source[/url]﻿ and is licensed under the [url=https://github.com/gzhynko/StardewMods/blob/master/LICENSE]0BSD License[/url]﻿.
